l: Yizani ke, Boni, yizani kwa nonke,
Usizi nalu lumi lodwa, Iintlungu naazi zimi zodwa,
I-Nkosi yehla ezulwini, Eyaba ngumntu ebantwini,
Ukholo lwethu looma phina? Ithemba lwethu looma phina?
